one_line: The model can now be built; whether it carries information cannot be determined from what this data supports.

independent_ke.note: circularity removed — no same-date price in any input; median Ke band 4.05-5.17pp, so every downstream number is an interval

pit_membership.note: seven origins, zero unresolved, departed firms recovered

payout_growth.note: three attempts, each adding a required term; admitted coverage 39.6-63.1% originally, 23.5-52.8% on corrected share counts

spx_successor.note: 12m incremental t 0.26-0.97 against a bound of 2; permutation 0 of 5; RI and EP paths disagree in sign at 24 and 36 months

why_inconclusive_is_not_negative: Five origins, 71-121 eligible firms per cross-section, 23-33% of index weight. A test this weak would fail to detect an effect that exists. The question was not answered; it was not answered negatively.
prototype_scope_held: S&P 500 only. No expansion to NDX, CCMP, SOX, KOSPI or RUT while SPX is INCONCLUSIVE.

process.verdict_not_revised_on_improved_measurem: B2-B stood on the instrument used to reach it; the correction happened to move the numbers down, so the verdict became more secure
statistics_defects_found_and_fixed: permutation did not permute — all p exactly 1.0; fixed, only the permutation rerun
share counts carried unit errors up to 648 trillion; sanity guard added

what_would_change_it: elapsed time with records kept — the G5 shadow archive and BACKLOG #380 are the only honest ways to grow the origin count
a payout rule not gated on clean-surplus admission, which currently excludes three quarters of index weight
third-year forecast coverage at the 2024 and 2025 origins, which collapse structurally
